name: Morehead State University
academic_ranking: 4-year public university in Morehead, KY (Town: Remote). Fall 2024 total enrollment ~8,791 (undergrad ~8,258). Admission rate ~77%, student-to-faculty ratio 16:1. Full-time retention ~65%; 6-year graduation rate ~52%. (Source: NCES College Navigator, 2024-25.)
financial_aid: In-state tuition & fees ~$10,024; out-of-state ~$14,980 (NCES 2024-25). 99% of full-time beginning undergrads receive some aid; 97% receive grant/scholarship aid averaging ~$11,976; 56% receive Pell grants. Average net price ~$9,630. Athletic scholarships administered per NCAA D1 softball limits.
facilities_notes: Softball plays at University Field on the Morehead State campus. (Facility name confirmed via athletics/Wikipedia; softball-specific amenities not detailed on the public softball page as of 2026-07.)
program_reputation: NCAA Division I program competing in the Ohio Valley Conference (OVC). Specific championship/NCAA tournament history was not confirmed from a live fetch during this research and should be verified before use.
